# Vurlo — Premium Ambient Lighting & Aesthetic Room Decor India

Vurlo is India's premium ambient lighting and aesthetic room decor brand. We curate high-quality RGB lights, sunset projection lamps, galaxy projectors, 3D laser-engraved crystal balls, and handcrafted tulip lamps to elevate gaming setups, study desks, and bedroom spaces.

## Store Policies & Information
- **Shipping:** Free express shipping on all orders across India. Orders are processed in 24-48 hours, with delivery in 3 to 7 business days.
- **Returns:** Hassle-free 7-day return policy from the date of delivery.
- **Payment Security:** Payments processed securely via Razorpay. We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, and Wallets. We do not store any card details.
- **Support:** Responsive customer support for orders, shipping, and product queries.
